name: @magda/agent-runtime
description: Managed DeepSeek Harness runtime for Magda Agent Workspace

scripts.check: bash -n entrypoint.sh && bash -n uv-wrapper.sh && node --check bootstrap.mjs && node --check dsh-launch.mjs && node --check session-history.mjs && node --check dsh-agent-skill-tools/lib/operations.js
scripts.test: yarn run check && node test-runtime.mjs && node test-workflow-capture.mjs && node test-session-history.mjs && node test-agent-skill-tools.mjs

docker.name: magda-agent-runtime
docker.include: node_modules Dockerfile dsh-client-managed-profile dsh-workflow-capture-guidance dsh-agent-skill-tools skills magda.cordis.patch.yml entrypoint.sh uv-wrapper.sh bootstrap.mjs dsh-launch.mjs session-history.mjs
